text:
maya: Quick Q — I'm switching the terraform module for billing to use Vault KV v2 and updating the ExternalSecret mapping. Anyone run into rotation issues with the ES operator we run? PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234

sam: which controller are you targeting? upstream external-secrets (external-secrets/external-secrets) or our forked build?

maya: upstream external-secrets, currently 1.8 in prod clusters.

liam: rotation itself should be fine. key gotcha: KV v2 uses the `secret/data/...` path and the property is nested under `data`. share your ExternalSecret snippet if you want a sanity check.

aaron: example we use in prod (works with KV v2):
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: billing-secret
spec:
  refreshInterval: "15m"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-prod
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: billing-creds
    template:
      type: Opaque
      dataFrom:
        - extract: true
  data:
    - secretKey: api_key
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/services/billing
        property: data.api_key
```

liam: yep — `key: secret/data/...` + `property: data.<field>` is the pattern. Also make sure the Vault policy allows `read` on that path and `list` if you rely on metadata.

sophia: note on rotation: if the app only reads env vars at startup you'll need a reload mechanism (sidecar, SIGHUP hook, or a rollout). We use a lightweight reload sidecar in billing to pick up rotated creds.

maya: thanks — in terraform I'm updating `vault_kv_mount` and the ExternalSecret resource in the helm values. For staging I set `externalsecrets.controller.refreshInterval=1m` to test rotation faster.

sam: small warning — 1m refresh is fine for staging but can spike CPU in prod; 15m or 30m is safer depending on traffic. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy started: infra/terraform apply for branch feature/kvv2-maya — plan OK -> apply queued

maya: noted. I'll keep prod at 15m. Updated the PR with infra/README docs about KV v2 mapping and an example ExternalSecret. https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234

aaron: I'll review the TF + helm diffs tomorrow morning. Recommend adding an `is_kv_v2` boolean in the module so mapping is explicit (and document property path behavior).

maya: good idea — I'll add that flag in a follow-up commit. After apply I'll run `kubectl get externalsecret -n billing -o yaml` and paste the result here.

liam: I can tail the external-secrets controller logs with you during the rollout if you want — helps catch permission errors quickly.

maya: that'd be awesome, thanks!
